title: Stop Exporting CRM Data: Query Deals Live with Claude #Shorts
description:
Learn how to connect Claude directly to Zoho CRM using an MCP server. Query your live pipeline, find stalled deals in plain English, and eliminate manual Excel exports.

1. Set up the Zoho MCP server configuration in your local AI client settings or environment variables.
2. Authorize secure read access to your Zoho CRM Deals module using your API scopes.
3. Type in plain English: 'Which enterprise deals have had no activity in 14 days?' and get an instant, actionable breakdown.

API / tool used:
- name: Zoho CRM Search Records API via MCP
- endpoint: POST https://www.zohoapis.com/crm/v3/Deals/search
- scope: ZohoCRM.modules.deals.READ
- docs: Zoho CRM API v3 Search Records

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

What inspired this: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxNREZFckxFcjdzbzJIZHdUVUZTTWRPTnhJQnVFNTk5Z1BaUlNObVg4eVZid2w3bTZORTN6dWhBM2h6bEEyOUdvNnU3VG50S1VWbnEtLVpEOEFtdXZ6UkVTUVlIYUN4Q2E3WUQ3UXp2ejdfS2VxY3JlMGViMFdpN2hwQUZEY1hQX2NTeW0tVGhxa09GUnNmdjlTbzJPT0hBSjh4TTZMSG13?oc=5

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
